context: A uni student debates current affairs with his teacher
purpose: Teach: 官房/省庁/起訴/告発/追及/朝刊/闘い/難民

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、今朝の朝刊、もう読まれましたか。官房長官の会見、ひどい内容でしたよ。
lines.en: Sensei, did you read this morning's paper? The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press conference was awful.
lines.style: Polite student opening a heated political debate

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。野党が責任を追及しているけれど、結局うやむやになるんじゃないかしら。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. The opposition is pursuing responsibility, but I wonder if it'll just fizzle out.
lines.style: Calm teacher responding with measured weary skepticism

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも今回は内部告発まで出てるんです。さすがに起訴は避けられないと思うんですが。
lines.en: But this time there's even a whistleblower. Surely indictment can't be avoided, I think.
lines.style: Earnest student pushing his argument forward firmly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 甘いわよ。省庁ぐるみでもみ消す可能性だってある。長年の闘いになるでしょうね。
lines.en: You're naive. The ministries could collectively cover it up. It'll become a long battle.
lines.style: Teacher cautioning student with weary jaded realism

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それと、難民認定の問題も気になっていて。日本は受け入れが少なすぎませんか。
lines.en: Also, the refugee recognition issue bothers me. Doesn't Japan accept far too few?
lines.style: Shifting topic with genuine personal moral concern

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: たしかに難しい問題ね。制度自体を見直さないと、何も変わらないわ。
lines.en: That really is a difficult issue. Without reviewing the system itself, nothing will change.
lines.style: Teacher acknowledging complexity thoughtfully and quite carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 卒論でこのテーマを扱いたいんです。先生、ご指導頂けないでしょうか。
lines.en: I want to address this theme in my thesis. Sensei, could I receive your guidance?
lines.style: Humble formal request to mentor for thesis

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん了承します。ただし、感情論ではなく、事実とデータで論じてくださいね。
lines.en: Of course I accept. However, please argue with facts and data, not just emotion.
lines.style: Teacher granting permission with firm scholarly condition
